macro.headline: Sticky Inflation & Geopolitical Risk Drive Defensive & Commodity Plays Amid Rate Uncertainty
themes: Inflation Persistence & Rate Vigilance: Global inflation remains elevated, prompting major central banks (Fed, RBA) to maintain a cautious 'higher for longer' interest rate stance, despite growing growth concerns.
Geopolitical Risk Premium: Ongoing conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East, alongside US-China strategic competition, keep global energy prices elevated and drive safe-haven flows into gold.

China's Economic Balancing Act: Focus remains on China's efforts to stabilise its property sector and stimulate broader economic growth, which will dictate industrial commodity demand (iron ore) and global trade sentiment.
